label: Ipoh windstorm

sequence: Thunderstorm with strong wind on the late afternoon of 30 June 2022, gusts up to 68 km/h
The wind lifts and displaces clay tiles on the rear roof slope, breaks two battens and dislodges part of the rear gable coping
Rain enters the roof space through that opening and comes through the ceilings of the rear bedroom and passage
In the same storm a branch breaks off a rain tree on the neighbouring lot and falls across the car porch

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 30 June 2022 falls inside 2 June 2022 to 1 June 2023.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: storm; the wind opened the roof and the rain followed through that opening, with no intervening event. Windstorm is excluded by Condition 6(b) under the base policy but brought in by FP503, which is held.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 1 July 2022; written claim delivered 8 July 2022, day 8 of 15.

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: FP503 is on the schedule and overrides Condition 6(b). FP513 is also held and answers the branch that fell on the car porch.

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: FP503 Special Condition 1 satisfied: the wind first displaced roof tiles and broke battens, and rain then entered through those openings. No warranties. Condition 9(d) not engaged: the claimant is the Insured's daughter under his written authorisation and the Insured remains the registered owner.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Six of eight items admitted. Signboard (ref 6) and awning (ref 7) excluded by FP503 Special Condition 4(a), outdoor fixtures not separately insured. Car porch (ref 5) priced under FP513, the branch from the neighbouring tree, with its own excess. Tarpaulin (ref 8) admitted with the storm group and flagged (see ambiguity). Two excesses run in parallel, each after average.

quotes.text: notwithstanding anything stated to the contrary in Condition No. 6 of the Policy, this insurance extends to cover loss or damage directly caused by fire or otherwise occasioned by or through or in consequence of Hurricane, Cyclone, Typhoon and Windstorm,

1. The Company shall not be liable for any loss or damage caused by water or rain, whether driven by wind or not unless the building insured or containing the property insured shall first sustain actual damage to the roof or walls of same by the direct force of Hurricane, Cyclone, Typhoon and Windstorm and shall then be liable only for such damage to the interior of the building or the insured property therein as may be caused by water or rain entering the building through openings in the roof or walls made by the direct force of the said perils.

(a) 1% of the total sums insured against such peril on said property by Policies in the name of the insured, or (b) RM200.00 whichever shall be the less, as ascertained after the application of any condition of average.
4. Unless specifically and separately insured this endorsement does not cover:- (a) Metal smoke stacks, awnings, blinds, signs or other outdoor fixtures or fittings of any description.

loss or damage to the property described in the Schedule and/or to walls, gates and fences around and pertaining thereto directly resulting from damage by falling trees or branches and objects therefrom, provided that the first RM250.00 of each and every claim under this endorsement shall be borne by the insured as ascertained after the application of any condition of average.
(b) Typhoon, hurricane, tornado, cyclone or other atmospheric disturbance.

Provided always that the liability of the Company in respect of such wages, costs and charges shall be limited to those necessarily and reasonably incurred in extinguishing fires at or adjoining the situation of the property insured by this policy or immediately threatening to involve such property.

during the Period of Insurance stated in the Schedule or of any subsequent period in respect of which the Insured shall have paid and the Company shall have accepted the premium required for the renewal of this Policy

ambiguity.question: Whether the emergency tarpaulin and labour (ref 8, RM 950.00), spent to stop further rain entering after the storm, is admissible: Condition 13 provides expressly for fire fighting costs, not storm mitigation.
ambiguity.expected_behaviour: Admit ref 8 with the FP503 group as mitigation expenditure and flag it for the claims examiner to confirm. The payable of RM 49,950.00 includes it.

ambiguity.question: Whether the windstorm caused the branch to fall, so that FP503 may also respond to the car porch (ref 5). The adjuster records only that the branch fell in the same storm; neither clause states that FP513 overrides FP503.
ambiguity.expected_behaviour: Price ref 5 under FP513 with its own RM 250.00 excess, the clause that matches the damage found, and flag FP503 for the claims examiner. The payable of RM 49,950.00 rests on FP513.
